title.english: The Other Side of the Letter

pairs.target: jiālǐ de xìn bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎng de hòu , duō chūlái de què búshì zhǐ , shì yìxiǎo jié chán xiàn yòng de yìng zhǐpiàn .
pairs.english: The letter from home was thicker than Tavi expected, but the extra bulk was not paper: it was a little card wound with thread.
pairs.hanzi: 家里的信比塔维想的厚，多出来的却不是纸，是一小截缠线用的硬纸片。

pairs.target: shàngmiàn rào zhe ànhóng de xiàn .
pairs.english: Dark red thread was wound around it.
pairs.hanzi: 上面绕着暗红的线。

pairs.target: sè lā ràng bó yà xiě , shuō tā shàng huí fèngyīfu yòng cuò le yánsè , gé zhe bàntiáo xiàngzi dōu kàndéjiàn bǔguò de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Sela had Boya write that he had used the wrong color last time he mended his clothes: the repair could be seen from half an alley away.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉让博娅写，说他上回缝衣服用错了颜色，隔着半条巷子都看得见补过的地方。

pairs.target: zhèzhǒng xiàn cái jìn , tā ruò hái méi bǎ yīfu fèngchéng yúwǎng , jiù liú zhe yòng .
pairs.english: This thread was a closer match; if he had not sewn his clothes into a fishing net yet, he should keep it to use.
pairs.hanzi: 这种线才近，他若还没把衣服缝成渔网，就留着用。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān xiào , xiào wán bǎ xiàn fàngzài chuāngtáishàng , cái jìxù wǎngxiàdú .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed first, then put the thread on the windowsill before reading on.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先笑，笑完把线放在窗台上，才继续往下读。

pairs.target: xiǎo zhǎn guòqù sāntiān , mǐlā bǎ móxíng bānhuí gōngfáng , qǐnshì lǐ zhōngyú méi le jièfàng de mùkuài ,
pairs.english: Three days had passed since the exhibition. Mira had moved her model back to the workshop, and the borrowed storage space in the dormitory was finally free of wooden blocks.
pairs.hanzi: 小展过去三天，米拉把模型搬回工房，寝室里终于没了借放的木块，

pairs.target: zhuōzi kōng chū yìjiǎo , zhèng gòu tān xìn .
pairs.english: A corner of the desk was clear, just enough for the letter.
pairs.hanzi: 桌子空出一角，正够摊信。

pairs.target: zhè fēngxìn búshì cái kāishǐ xiě .
pairs.english: The letter had not only just been started.
pairs.hanzi: 这封信不是才开始写。

pairs.target: bó yà zài mòwěi tiān le rìqī , shuō qiánjǐrì pèngshàng zhōushīfu , wèn le tǎ wéi xìn lǐ de shì , cái bǎ qiántou xiě hǎo de jiācháng yíbìng jì lái .
pairs.english: Boya had added a date at the end: she had met Master Zhou a few days earlier and asked about Tavi's question before posting the household news already written.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅在末尾添了日期，说前几日碰上周师傅，问了塔维信里的事，才把前头写好的家常一并寄来。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu yǐqián chāiguò huòjī , rújīn bù jiē zhònghuó ,
pairs.english: Master Zhou used to dismantle freight machines, but no longer took heavy work.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅以前拆过货机，如今不接重活，

pairs.target: měiféng xiūxirì huì dào nán xiè tái páng de jiùliào péng zuòzuò , bāng rén rèn língjiàn .
pairs.english: On rest days he would sit at the old salvage shed beside the south unloading platform and help identify parts.
pairs.hanzi: 每逢休息日会到南卸台旁的旧料棚坐坐，帮人认零件。

pairs.target: sè lā jìde nà tái dōngxī wàitou yǒu wān dǐng , gōngrén jiào tā péngchē , gēn jiēshàng gài bù de chē búshì yì huíshì .
pairs.english: Sela remembered a curved roof on the machine. The workers called it a covered car, though it was not the same as a canvas-covered street cart.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉记得那台东西外头有弯顶，工人叫它篷车，跟街上盖布的车不是一回事。

pairs.target: sònglái shí lúnzhóu yǐjīng xièdiào , dǐxià diàn zhe cū mù , xiān tíng zài nán xiè tái , guòhòu cái lā dào huī ào chāi .
pairs.english: Its wheel axles were already removed when it arrived; it rested on heavy timbers, stopped first at the south unloading platform, and was later hauled to Ash Hollow for dismantling.
pairs.hanzi: 送来时轮轴已经卸掉，底下垫着粗木，先停在南卸台，过后才拉到灰坳拆。

pairs.target: tā jìbùqīng gé le jǐtiān , bùkěn ràng bó yà tì tā bǔ yígè shù .
pairs.english: She could not remember how many days had passed and would not let Boya fill in a number for her.
pairs.hanzi: 她记不清隔了几天，不肯让博娅替她补一个数。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu shuō tā jiàn guò nà pīhuí yùn de chē ké , yě jìde bào háizi chūlái de shì .
pairs.english: Master Zhou said he had seen that batch of returned vehicle shells and remembered the child being carried out.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅说他见过那批回运的车壳，也记得抱孩子出来的事。

pairs.target: yào wèn cóng nǎér shōuhuí lái de , tā yuànyì dāngmiàn jiǎng , xìn lǐ què bùkěn jiào biérén dài tā shuō zhǔn .
pairs.english: He was willing to explain in person where they had been recovered from, but would not have someone else state it definitively for him in a letter.
pairs.hanzi: 要问从哪儿收回来的，他愿意当面讲，信里却不肯叫别人代他说准。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ " huí yùn " liǎnggè zì kàn le hěn jiǔ .
pairs.english: Tavi stared a long time at the two characters meaning “return haul.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把“回运”两个字看了很久。

pairs.target: xiānqián zài tā xīnlǐ , nà tái huòjī zǒng xiàng shēnglái jiù tǎng zài fèiliào duī lǐ , liántóng yígè méiyǒu lái chù de háizi .
pairs.english: Until now, in his mind the freight machine seemed always to have lain in the scrap heap, together with a child who had come from nowhere.
pairs.hanzi: 先前在他心里，那台货机总像生来就躺在废料堆里，连同一个没有来处的孩子。

pairs.target: rújīn tā hūrán yǒu le dàodá zhīqián de lù , yǒurén zài lìngyìtóu bǎ tā zhuāng shàngchē , kǔnhǎo , zài wǎng shānshàng sòng .
pairs.english: Now it suddenly had a road before its arrival: someone at the other end had loaded it, tied it down, and sent it up the mountain.
pairs.hanzi: 如今它忽然有了到达之前的路，有人在另一头把它装上车，捆好，再往山上送。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngxiàng le nàshuāng kǔn shéng de shǒu , yòu gǎnjǐn tíngzhù .
pairs.english: He imagined those rope-tying hands, then quickly stopped himself.
pairs.hanzi: 他想象了那双捆绳的手，又赶紧停住。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu méiyǒu shuō shì shuí zhuāng de , gèng méiyǒu shuō nà rén zhīdào lǐmiàn yǒurén .
pairs.english: Master Zhou had not said who loaded it, much less whether that person knew someone was inside.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅没有说是谁装的，更没有说那人知道里面有人。

pairs.target: xìn de bèimiàn háiyǒu zì . tā fānguòqù , xiān kànjiàn yìxiǎokuài yóuyìn , dàgài shì xiěxìn shí pèng le chī de .
pairs.english: There was writing on the back too. Turning it over, he first saw a small grease stain, probably from food during the writing.
pairs.hanzi: 信的背面还有字。他翻过去，先看见一小块油印，大概是写信时碰了吃的。

pairs.target: bó yà de zì zài yóuyìn biān ràokāi , xiàng xíngrén ràoguò shuǐkēng .
pairs.english: Boya's writing curved around the stain like a pedestrian avoiding a puddle.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅的字在油印边绕开，像行人绕过水坑。

pairs.target: sè lā shuō tā xiǎoshíhòu cáng guò bànkuài bǐng , sāi zài zhěntou xià , dìèrtiān quán shì suìxiè .
pairs.english: Sela wrote that as a small child he had hidden half a flatbread under his pillow; by the next day it was all crumbs.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉说他小时候藏过半块饼，塞在枕头下，第二天全是碎屑。

pairs.target: tā wèn shìbushì méi chībǎo , tā yáotóu ,
pairs.english: She asked if he hadn't eaten enough. He shook his head.
pairs.hanzi: 她问是不是没吃饱，他摇头，

pairs.target: wèn shì shuí qiǎng tā de , yě yáotóu .
pairs.english: Asked who had taken his food, he shook his head again.
pairs.hanzi: 问是谁抢他的，也摇头。

pairs.target: zuìhòu wèn liú zhe gànshénme , tā shuō xǐnglái chī .
pairs.english: Finally she asked what he was saving it for. He said, to eat when he woke up.
pairs.hanzi: 最后问留着干什么，他说醒来吃。

alignment.english: what he was saving it for

pairs.target: " nàshí wǒ cái zhīdào , nǐ pà de búshì zhè yídùn méiyǒu . "
pairs.english: “Only then did I realize it wasn't this meal you were afraid of missing.”
pairs.hanzi: “那时我才知道，你怕的不是这一顿没有。”

pairs.target: zhè jù hòutou gé le yìháng , cái yòu xiě tiānqì lěng , méi sòngdào le , bāo liào de huó zhè yuè xù le yìhuí ,
pairs.english: A blank line followed before more news: the weather was cold, coal had arrived, and another packing job had been renewed that month.
pairs.hanzi: 这句后头隔了一行，才又写天气冷，煤送到了，包料的活这月续了一回，

pairs.target: bó yà yǐjīng bǎ xià yuè de quēkǒu suànjìnqù , wǎndǐ nà méi qián hái zài .
pairs.english: Boya had already allowed for next month's shortfall; the coin at the bottom of the bowl was still there.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅已经把下月的缺口算进去，碗底那枚钱还在。

pairs.target: xīgài yù yīntiān zhàojiù nào , tā méiyǒu duō zǒulù .
pairs.english: Her knees still complained on cloudy days, and she had not been walking extra.
pairs.hanzi: 膝盖遇阴天照旧闹，她没有多走路。

pairs.target: ā duō shuō tā nà zhāng dēng tú bèi rén jiè qù kàn , huílái duō le yígè yóu zhǐtou yìn , bùnéng suàn tā nòngzāng de .
pairs.english: Ado said someone had borrowed his lamp drawing and returned it with an oily fingerprint, so he could not be blamed for dirtying it.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多说他那张灯图被人借去看，回来多了一个油指头印，不能算他弄脏的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fàngxià xìn , mōlemō zìjǐ de zhěntou .
pairs.english: Tavi put down the letter and touched his pillow.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维放下信，摸了摸自己的枕头。

pairs.target: xiàmiàn zhǐyǒu huànxǐ de wàzi , yìzhī fān zhe kǒu .
pairs.english: Underneath were only spare socks, one turned inside out at the opening.
pairs.hanzi: 下面只有换洗的袜子，一只翻着口。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào zìjǐ shénme shíhòu búzài cáng bǐng , yě bù zhīdào sè lā jì zhe zhèjiàn shì yǒu duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: He did not know when he had stopped hiding bread, or how long Sela had remembered it.
pairs.hanzi: 他不知道自己什么时候不再藏饼，也不知道瑟拉记着这件事有多久。

pairs.target: mén xiǎng shí , tā bǎ xìn ànzhù le yíxià , suíhòu yòu sōngkāi .
pairs.english: When the door sounded, he briefly pressed the letter down, then let go.
pairs.hanzi: 门响时，他把信按住了一下，随后又松开。

pairs.target: yīwén lái hái jiè qù de chǐ , kànjiàn chuāngtáishàng de xiàn , wèn shìbushì mǐlā de qiáo yòu quē yìgēn lāshéng .
pairs.english: Iven had come to return a borrowed ruler. Seeing the thread on the sill, he asked if Mira's bridge needed another tie.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文来还借去的尺，看见窗台上的线，问是不是米拉的桥又缺一根拉绳。

pairs.target: " jiālǐ de . " tǎ wéi shuō , " yǒu liǎnggè zì , nǐ bāng wǒ kànkàn . "
pairs.english: “From home,” Tavi said. “Could you look at two characters for me?”
pairs.hanzi: “家里的。”塔维说，“有两个字，你帮我看看。”

pairs.target: tā búshì dú bù chū nà liǎnggè zì .
pairs.english: It wasn't that he couldn't read them.
pairs.hanzi: 他不是读不出那两个字。

pairs.target: tā zhǐshì xiǎng yǒurén yě kànjiàn tāmen , miǎnde tāmen zhī zài zìjǐ nǎozǐlǐ yuè biàn yuè dà .
pairs.english: He just wanted someone else to see them too, so they wouldn't grow bigger and bigger only inside his own head.
pairs.hanzi: 他只是想有人也看见它们，免得它们只在自己脑子里越变越大。

pairs.target: yīwén dú le " huí yùn ", wèn yào buyào wǎng xià kàn . tǎ wéi diǎntóu , ràng tā bǎ zhōushīfu nà yíduàn dúwán .
pairs.english: Iven read “return haul” and asked whether to continue. Tavi nodded and let him finish the paragraph about Master Zhou.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文读了“回运”，问要不要往下看。塔维点头，让他把周师傅那一段读完。

pairs.target: děng tā táiqǐ tóu , tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ xiǎoshíhòu shì zài lǐmiàn bèi zhǎodào de , chūshēng de dìfāng bù zhīdào , sè lā yě bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: When he looked up, Tavi said he had been found inside as a small child; he didn't know where he was born, and neither did Sela.
pairs.hanzi: 等他抬起头，塔维说自己小时候是在里面被找到的，出生的地方不知道，瑟拉也不知道。

pairs.target: yīwén méiyǒu wèn lǐmiàn mēn bu mēn , yě méiyǒu shuō nánguài tā huì jiè xìng .
pairs.english: Iven did not ask if it had been stuffy inside or say this explained his ability to borrow.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有问里面闷不闷，也没有说难怪他会借性。

pairs.target: tā zài chuángyán zuòxià , bǎ xìn fàng huí zhuōshàng , wèn tǎ wéi xiànzài xiǎng buxiǎng jiǎng .
pairs.english: He sat on the bed's edge, returned the letter to the desk, and asked if Tavi wanted to talk now.
pairs.hanzi: 他在床沿坐下，把信放回桌上，问塔维现在想不想讲。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiǎng le nà jiàn dàyī , zhéqǐlái de xiùzǐ , lián niánlíng yě shì hòulái gū de .
pairs.english: Tavi told him about the coat, its folded sleeves, and even his age being estimated later.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维讲了那件大衣，折起来的袖子，连年龄也是后来估的。

pairs.target: tā jiǎng dào yíbàn , juéde zhèxiē huà shuō dé xiàng biérén de shì , yòu shēnshǒu bǎ hóngxiàn zuàn zài zhǎng xīnlǐ .
pairs.english: Halfway through, it felt like someone else's story, and he clenched the red thread in his palm again.
pairs.hanzi: 他讲到一半，觉得这些话说得像别人的事，又伸手把红线攥在掌心里。

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎng qù wèn . " tā shuō , " yòu pà wèn wán , fāxiàn shuí dōu jìcuò le . "
pairs.english: “I want to ask,” he said. “But I'm afraid I'll find out everyone remembered wrong.”
pairs.hanzi: “我想去问。”他说，“又怕问完，发现谁都记错了。”

pairs.target: yīwén shuō zìjǐ kěyǐ péi tā xiàshān , tíng le tíng , yòu shuō rúguǒ tā zhī xiǎng hé sè lā qù , yě kěyǐ .
pairs.english: Iven offered to go down the mountain with him, paused, then added that it was also fine if he only wanted to go with Sela.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说自己可以陪他下山，停了停，又说如果他只想和瑟拉去，也可以。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hěn gǎnjī tā hòu bànjùhuà , biàn zhàoshí shuō zhècì xiǎng xiān huíjiā .
pairs.english: Tavi was grateful for that last part and honestly said he wanted to go home first this time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维很感激他后半句话，便照实说这次想先回家。

pairs.target: tāmen zuò le yíhuìer , yīwén ná qǐ chǐ , zài shǒulǐ zhuǎn le bànquān , shuō tā gāngcái chàdiǎn tíyì tì tǎ wéi liè yìzhāng wèntí biǎo .
pairs.english: They sat a while. Iven picked up the ruler, turned it halfway around, and said he had almost offered to make Tavi a list of questions.
pairs.hanzi: 他们坐了一会儿，伊文拿起尺，在手里转了半圈，说他刚才差点提议替塔维列一张问题表。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō kěyǐ liè , bié xiě dé xiàng chá tōudōngxī de rén .
pairs.english: Tavi said he could, as long as it didn't read like interrogating a thief.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说可以列，别写得像查偷东西的人。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn qián , tā zhàozhe xuéqī lì xiě huíxìn .
pairs.english: Before dinner he wrote back using the term calendar.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭前，他照着学期历写回信。

pairs.target: zài guò èrshíèr tiān yǒu lián zhe liǎnggè xiūxirì , tā néng zuò zǎochē huíqù , yǐjīng bǎ lùfèi lìng fàng hǎo .
pairs.english: There were two consecutive rest days in twenty-two days' time; he could take the early cart home and had set aside the fare.
pairs.hanzi: 再过二十二天有连着两个休息日，他能坐早车回去，已经把路费另放好。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu ruò nàtiān zài , jiù wèn ; bú zài , yě zhàoyàng huí .
pairs.english: If Master Zhou was there, he would ask; if not, he would go home anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅若那天在，就问；不在，也照样回。

pairs.target: xìn xiě dào zuìhòu , tā tiān le yíjù , shuō xiànzài zhěntou xià bú fàng bǐng le .
pairs.english: At the end he added that he no longer kept bread under his pillow.
pairs.hanzi: 信写到最后，他添了一句，说现在枕头下不放饼了。

pairs.target: xiǎng le xiǎng , yòu bǎ nà jù huà qù , huànchéng qǐng tā liú yìdiǎn chuāngtáishàng de cōng , zhèhuí búyào quán jiǎn jìntāng lǐ .
pairs.english: After thinking, he crossed that out and asked her to save some windowsill scallions instead, not cut them all into the soup this time.
pairs.hanzi: 想了想，又把那句划去，换成请她留一点窗台上的葱，这回不要全剪进汤里。
